Directions: Refer to the code from the GridWorld case study, then answer each question that follows. A copy of the code is provided in the Appendix.
Content: Consider the design of a `tttext(Grasshopper)` class that extends `tttext(Bug)`. When asked to move, a `tttext(Grasshopper)` moves to a randomly chosen empty adjacent location that is within the grid. If there is no empty adjacent location that is within the grid, the `tttext(Grasshopper)` does not move, but turns `45` `text(degrees)` to the right without changing its location.
